native.name: Native
native.description: Built-in cache types (f16, q8_0, q4_0, etc.). Maximum compatibility.

turboquant.name: TurboQuant
turboquant.description: Hadamard-rotation KV quantization. 2–4× compression with minimal quality loss.

triattention.name: TriAttention
triattention.description: Sparse attention compressor for long context. Apple Silicon + CUDA.

fbcache.name: First Block Cache
fbcache.description: Diffusion-only cache hook. ~1.8× speedup on DiT pipelines.

taylorseer.name: TaylorSeer
taylorseer.description: Diffusion-only Taylor-expansion cache. Aggressive speedup, FLUX/SD3.

magcache.name: MagCache
magcache.description: Diffusion-only magnitude-based cache. FLUX only without calibration.

fusedAttention.label: Fused attention
fusedAttention.body: Fused attention uses optimized attention kernels when the selected backend supports them. It can improve throughput and reduce overhead, but some model/backend combinations may prefer the standard attention path for compatibility.

dflash.tooltip: DFlash speculative decoding: 3-5x faster generation with zero quality loss.
dflash.label: DFlash
dflash.body: DFlash uses a small draft model to propose multiple tokens in parallel, then verifies them in a single forward pass. This gives 3-5x faster generation with zero quality loss.
dflash.requiresBody: Apple Silicon + dflash-mlx, or Linux/CUDA + dflash. Compatible draft model for the target.
